name: vise
description: Phase-gated workflow enforcer, cross-project experience memory, and git snapshots for Claude Code

goal_gate.title: Goal gate
goal_gate.description: Hold the turn open while an active vise goal is unfinished (the Stop hook). Same as VISE_GOAL_GATE=1, which wins when set.

snapshot_on_edit.title: Snapshot on every edit
snapshot_on_edit.description: Take a git snapshot before edits and destructive shell commands, not only on phase transitions. Same as VISE_SNAPSHOT_ON_EDIT=1, which wins when set.

codelayer.title: Read-by-symbol gate
codelayer.description: off (inert), warn (records what it would deny, blocks nothing) or enforce (denies source reads by path). Any other value leaves it off. Same as VISE_CODELAYER, which wins when set.

workflow_suggest.title: Workflow and /loop suggestions
workflow_suggest.description: Suggest a workflow for multi-step prompts, and /loop for work that outlives the turn. Same as VISE_WORKFLOW_SUGGEST=0 to turn it off, which wins when set.
